pattern_explanation: The Polish words in this set look close to certain English words by coincidence or through distant shared roots, so learners can be misled when they translate by sound or spelling alone.
false_friend_warning: Warning: the Polish word 'gumka' (transliterated) means eraser, but it looks like the English word 'gum', which means chewing gum, so learners must not translate 'gumka' as 'gum'.
